title: Arnold’s Mini-Golf
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Arrgh, matey! Play beside a pirate ship and through a treasure chest! Spectacular water features and waterfalls provide a cooling mist on warm summer days. The landscaping with its lush floral design will inspire you to return home and spruce up your garden. Hand-crafted, scaled replicas, in miniature, of Lower Cape Cod historical landmarks are exact in their re-creation and informative as well.
